g.text: Housing-market figures: Redfin Data Center ZIP-code tracker, all residential, 3 months ending May 2026. ZIP values are apportioned to each ring by area overlap (assumes sales are spread

text.style: font-size: 5.6px; font-family: 'Inter'; fill: #5c6773

g.text: evenly across a ZIP), so they are estimates; the price is a sales-weighted average of ZIP medians, not a true ring median. ZIP areas are Census 2010 ZCTAs. Population, household and income
